retry_queue.title: CVE-2019-25763 — CVSS 9.8 CRITICAL Severity | Patch Required
retry_queue.summary: WordPress Ultimate Addons for Beaver Builder 1.2.4.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows attackers to gain unauthorized access by exploiting the social media login form functionality. Attackers can submit a POST request to the admin-ajax.php endpoint with the uabb-lf-google-submit action, a valid administrator email address, and a valid nonce to obtain session cookies and authenticate as that user. CVSS Score: 9.8 CWE: CWE-288
retry_queue.full_content:
CVE ID: CVE-2019-25763
Description: WordPress Ultimate Addons for Beaver Builder 1.2.4.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows attackers to gain unauthorized access by exploiting the social media login form functionality. CVSS Score: 9.8
